fact: 1924年8月16日，道威斯计划被各国正式接受，9月1日生效。计划规定：德国第一年赔款10亿帝国马克，逐年递增到第五年的25亿；美国向德国贷款约8亿金马克（2亿美元）稳定币值；法比军队撤出鲁尔；德国的金融外汇、铁路运营和税捐征收事务受国际监管；发行110亿金马克铁路公债和50亿金马克工业公债。

sources.title: British Online Archives, 100 Years Since The Dawes Plan Was Accepted
sources.quote: The Dawes Plan was accepted by Germany and the Allies on 16 August 1924. It came into effect on 1 September 1924. ... The plan stipulated that Germany had to resume payment of reparations, beginning with a sum of one billion Reichsmarks in the first year, increasing annually to two and a half billion after five years. ... The USA would loan Germany 800 million Reichsmarks to ensure the stability of the currency.

sources.title: 今日头条（国家人文历史），「金融巫师」临危受命
sources.quote: 由协约国监督改组德意志银行,实行货币改革,并由协约国贷款8亿金马克(折合1.9亿美元)以稳定其币值,在赔款总数尚未最后确定的情况下,规定德国赔款年度限额,即由第一年(1924—1925)10亿金马克开始,逐年增加,到第五年(1928—1929)增至年付25亿金马克;德国支付赔款的财源来自关税、烟酒糖专卖税、铁路收入及工商企业税;发行110亿金马克铁路公债、50亿金马克工业公债。

fact: 1924年8月30日，《银行法》通过，对帝国银行进行全面改革，使其首次成为明确独立的中央银行。管理委员会由7名德国人和7名外国人组成，设一名外国「货币专员」监督纸币发行。帝国银行向政府放贷的能力受到严格限制。新货币帝国马克（Reichsmark）定为1万亿旧纸马克，恢复战前2790帝国马克/公斤黄金的平价。旧纸币于1925年6月5日停止法偿。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Reichsbank
sources.quote: The Banking Law of 30 August 1924 was inspired by the stabilization loans orchestrated by the Economic and Financial Organization of the League of Nations. It comprehensively reformed the Reichsbank and made it, for the first time, an explicitly independent central bank. Its Kuratorium was replaced by a General Council consisting of 7 German and 7 foreign members, which was to elect the bank's president subject to approval of the President of Germany. The General Council also elected one of its foreign members to serve as Currency Commissioner supervising note issuance. The ability of the reformed Reichsbank to extend credit to the Reich government was strictly limited. The new currency, the Reichsmark (RM), was set at one trillion paper Mark, restoring the prewar parity of 2790 RM for one kilogram of fine gold.

fact: 1924年8月，法比军队开始撤离鲁尔区（道威斯计划规定在1925年8月前完成撤军）。1924年10月，对德贷款正式发行，美国认购了其中一半以上的份额，英国认购四分之一以上。1923年11月23日煤业辛迪加与法比签订协议后，鲁尔煤炭重新向协约国交付。

sources.title: 中文维基百科，凡尔赛体系
sources.quote: 1924年8月,在伦敦召开的一次会议上,各国正式接受了道威斯计划。此时,法比两国军队也撤出鲁尔区。同年10月,向德国提供的贷款正式发行,美国认购了其中一半以上的份额,英国则认购其中四分之一以上。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Weimar Republic
sources.quote: The French and Belgian occupation ended in August 1925, following an agreement (the Dawes Plan) to restructure Germany's payments.

fact: 道威斯计划后的美国资本大量涌入德国，形成了资金循环：美国银行向德国放贷→德国工业恢复→德国向英法支付赔款→英法向美国偿还战债。1920—1931年德国赔款总支出230亿马克，其中125亿为现金（主要来自纽约银行贷款）。德国从贷款中获得的资金超过了它实际支付的赔款。1924—1929年德国经济进入「黄金二十年代」，工业产出超过战前水平。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Weimar Republic
sources.quote: The total reparations payout from 1920 to 1931 (when payments were suspended indefinitely) was 23 billion marks. 12.5 billion was cash that came mostly from loans provided by New York bankers. The rest was goods such as coal and chemicals, or from assets like railway equipment.

sources.title: GRO Learning, Stresemann and the Recovery of Germany
sources.quote: The Dawes Plan of 1924 did not cancel reparations – Germany still owed the money – but it restructured payments into amounts the German economy could actually bear, and it opened the door to large-scale American investment. US banks lent money to German industry and municipalities throughout the mid-1920s. German factories modernised. Unemployment fell. Tax revenues increased.

fact: 1924年8月沙赫特完成旧马克兑换新帝国马克的过程（1帝国马克=1万亿旧纸马克），马克汇率在国际市场上趋于稳定。帝国马克恢复战前2790马克/公斤黄金的平价。国际投机者逐渐停止对马克的攻击。1924年后帝国银行的信用配给（贴现率不超过10%）持续到1926年初。

sources.title: 今日头条（国家人文历史），「金融巫师」临危受命
sources.quote: 沙赫特用国家银行黄金储备为基础的新马克,以一比三十亿的悬殊比率兑换旧马克,到1924年8月这个过程基本完成,马克汇率开始在国际市场上稳定下来,国际投机者逐渐停止了对它的攻击。折磨德国的漫长通货膨胀终于结束了。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Reichsbank
sources.quote: In the subsequent period of deflation, the Reichsbank became practically the only source of short-term banking credit in the German economy, which it chose to ration (maintaining a discount rate of no more than 10 percent) rather than lending to high market-determined rates.

fact: 1924年货币稳定后，德国物价恢复到可预测的水平。帝国马克的购买力稳定，日常交易不再需要每天两次发工资或用物物交换。但失业率仍然偏高（即使在黄金二十年代最好年份约130万），农业部门持续衰退，农村地区未分享到城市工业繁荣。

sources.title: GRO Learning, Stresemann and the Recovery of Germany
sources.quote: High unemployment - Even during the best years, unemployment hovered around 1.3 million, indicating that prosperity did not reach all sections of society. Wealth inequality - Economic gains were unevenly distributed, with industrialists and urban workers benefiting more than rural communities or the unemployed.

sources.title: ConvexTrade, Hyperinflation
sources.quote: How it ended: On November 15, 1923, the Rentenmark was introduced at a rate of 1 Rentenmark = 1 trillion old marks. It was backed by a mortgage on all German land and industrial assets, a credible hard-asset backing that immediately restored confidence. Prices stabilized within days.

fact: 1924年《银行法》使帝国银行独立于政府，并设外国货币专员监督纸币发行——这是协约国对德国金融主权的直接介入。德国的金融外汇、铁路运营和税捐征收事务受国际监管。外国资本进入德国的法律框架在道威斯计划后逐步建立，但德国国内对「外国监管」的不满持续存在，成为后来民族主义运动的燃料。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Reichsbank
sources.quote: The General Council also elected one of its foreign members to serve as Currency Commissioner supervising note issuance. The ability of the reformed Reichsbank to extend credit to the Reich government was strictly limited.

sources.quote: 德国的金融外汇、铁路运营以及税捐征收事务受国际监管。

fact: 1924年后德国工业进入合理化（rationalization）时期：采用流水线等高效生产技术提升钢铁和制造业生产率；化工和电气等新兴行业快速发展；交通网络、住房和公共工程投资（多由外国贷款资助）支撑经济活动。工业产出超过战前水平，德国重新成为欧洲领先工业国。

sources.title: Cognito, Dawes Plan, Young Plan & Structural Problems
sources.quote: Rationalisation and modernisation - Industries adopted efficient production techniques, such as assembly lines, boosting productivity in sectors like steel and manufacturing. Growth of new sectors - Emerging industries, including chemicals and electrical goods, thrived, reflecting technological advancements and innovation. Infrastructure improvements - Investments in transport networks, housing, and public works, often funded by foreign loans, supported economic activity and urban development.
